verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments product, since self-hostable payment platforms exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows PayPal's core payment service can be self-hosted: it is consumed as hosted REST APIs and dashboards. The locally runnable MCP server (`npx @paypal/mcp`) is only a thin client wrapper around PayPal's hosted APIs, not the core product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
